channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Meta launches Spaces in Muse — describe an idea and Muse builds a persistent custom experience
item.description: Meta launched Spaces in Muse: describe an idea in chat and Muse builds a persistent custom experience like a tracker, planner, or project board in the sidebar.

item.title: firmly raises $15M Series A and launches Ask Agent in-chat checkout
item.description: firmly raised a $15M Series A and launched Ask Agent, letting shoppers discover products and check out inside a chat on merchant websites.

item.title: Cowboy raises $5M seed to launch an app store for AI agents
item.description: Cowboy raised a $5M seed round to launch an app store for AI agents, opening with more than 100 agents and 10,000 data feeds.

item.title: Anthropic launches Personal Finance in Claude (US beta) — read-only bank linking via Plaid
item.description: Anthropic launched Personal Finance in Claude in US beta: link bank and card accounts via Plaid and ask Claude about your money — read-only, it can't move funds.

item.title: Kalepa raises $75M Series B at a $470M valuation for AI agents in insurance underwriting
item.description: Kalepa raised $75M at a $470M valuation for AI agents that handle insurance underwriting, and plans to double headcount by 2027.

item.title: AvePoint launches Trust Platform to govern enterprise AI agents, models and MCP servers
item.description: AvePoint launched a Trust Platform to govern enterprise AI agents, models and MCP servers, including discovery of shadow AI.

item.title: Wolters Kluwer ships a TyMetrix 360° MCP server for governed legal invoice workflows
item.description: Wolters Kluwer launched an MCP server for TyMetrix 360°, letting legal teams run invoice workflows in one AI conversation under existing permissions.

item.title: Meta moves WhatsApp marketing templates to a dedicated API; Cloud API marketing ends Oct 13, 2027
item.description: Meta is moving WhatsApp marketing messages to a dedicated API: Cloud API marketing sends stop working on October 13, 2027.

item.title: METR: Anthropic's benchmark capability progress accelerated ~1.9x since Oct 2025
item.description: Independent evaluator METR estimates Anthropic's AI capability progress accelerated about 1.9x since October 2025, with key evidence redacted.

item.title: Nooks raises $500M and launches Node, a proactive AI assistant for sales reps
item.description: Nooks raises $500M and launches Node, a proactive AI assistant for sales reps

item.title: Descope launches Envoy, a delegated sign-in path for personal AI agents with Poppy support
item.description: Descope launches Envoy, a delegated sign-in path for personal AI agents with Poppy support

item.title: x402 reality check: counts climb, but the average payment has shrunk to about $0.05
item.description: New on-chain data shows x402 agent payments are steady in count but far below their late-2025 peak, with the average payment down to about five cents.

item.title: CoinGecko halves x402 data costs to $0.005 per call and adds Polygon USDC payments
item.description: CoinGecko cut its x402 crypto data price in half to $0.005 per call and added USDC payments on Polygon alongside Base and Solana.

item.title: Roundhouse AI adds Solana to its x402 payments dashboard
item.description: Roundhouse AI added Solana to its x402 payments dashboard, which now tracks over 202 million agent payments worth $45.6 million across three blockchains.

item.title: COOCON and DSRV partner to build AI-agent stablecoin payments on x402
item.description: COOCON and DSRV partner to build AI-agent stablecoin payments on x402

item.description: Box makes agent security controls generally available at BoxWorks 2026

item.description: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model rated Critical, for vetted defenders only

item.description: Tencent's Hunyuan Hy4 goes generally available: open-weight model with vision and computer use

item.description: Phaze raises $8.75M seed to give AI agents remote access to powerful workstations

item.title: Ocient raises $100M Series C to accelerate agentic AI analytics
item.description: Ocient raised $100M in Series C funding to accelerate its agentic AI analytics platform for petabyte-scale data, bringing total funding to $260M.

item.title: Microsoft adds Dynamic Permissions and Execution Containers for agent security
item.description: Microsoft added task-scoped Dynamic Permissions for AI agents, made Execution Containers generally available, and expanded Defender to discover local agents and their MCP setups.

item.title: x402 passes 197 million settled payments
item.description: A live tracker counts over 197 million x402 payments settled and $42.45 million in volume as of November 5, with Base the largest chain.

item.title: Orca extends AI AppGen Security to Base44's Compliance API
item.description: Orca Security extended its AI AppGen Security platform to Base44 on day one of Base44's new Compliance API, checking no-code workspaces against 30+ security rules.

item.title: Sand.ai raises $200M Series A+ for generative video models
item.description: Sand.ai raised $200M in Series A+ funding to build generative video models, bringing its 2026 total to about $300M.

item.title: Cyberhaven launches Agentic Data Security to watch what AI agents do with company data
item.description: Cyberhaven launched Agentic Data Security, which shows what AI agents do with company data and stops sensitive data before it leaves.

item.title: Citrix adds SecurSpaces and SecurAccess for governed agentic work
item.description: Citrix added SecurSpaces and SecurAccess, giving AI agents isolated sandboxes and audited sessions inside enterprise workspaces.

item.title: Fingerprint can now detect hidden Muse, Instinct and Grok bot traffic
item.description: Fingerprint expanded bot detection to identify undeclared traffic from AI agents including Meta's Muse, Instinct and xAI's Grok Bot.

item.title: Base44 and Overwolf's Nitro launch $65K contest for AI-built web games
item.description: Base44 and Overwolf's Nitro launched a $65K contest for web games built with AI, with a $25,000 grand prize.

item.title: OpenAI ships ChatGPT Images 2.6 with animated GIFs and two new API models
item.description: OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.6 with animated GIFs and two faster API models, Flare and Sunburst, for quicker image generation and editing.

item.title: Anthropic expands Claude Marketplace with 14 new partner agents
item.description: Anthropic added 14 partner agents to Claude Marketplace, including security and productivity tools, now payable from committed Anthropic spend.

item.title: Anthropic adds message threads to Messages API in public beta
item.description: Anthropic added message threads to its Messages API in public beta, caching conversations server-side to cut latency on long Claude Code sessions.

item.title: WhatsApp Business Platform: INR billing migration deadline is Dec 31, 2026
item.description: Indian businesses on WhatsApp must switch messaging accounts to INR billing by December 31, 2026, or messages stop delivering from January 1.

item.description: x402 agent payments passed 196 million settled transactions and $42.4 million in volume, though October cooled sharply after a late-2025 minting frenzy.

item.title: PhoenixAI launches Contextbase, governed context infrastructure for AI agents
item.description: PhoenixAI launched Contextbase, putting agent memory, knowledge, traces and evaluations in one governed store inside its database.

item.title: Brava Security raises $15M seed to expand AI SecOps in North America
item.description: Brava Security raised $15 million to build AI agents that test whether security tools would actually catch an attack.

item.title: Leidos unveils HeadWay Dispatch for cross-vendor AI agent control
item.description: Leidos launched HeadWay Dispatch, a platform to govern AI agents from different vendors with risk-based autonomy controls.
